NeoGeoSDK v1.7.1 - separate NeoSD hardware tests
=============================================

The original AES_v1 and MVS_v1 images have not been replaced.
Both new files retain the original 8 MiB V1 layout and container lengths.

MVS: Maiya-WIP-NeoSD_MVS_SOUND_FIX_PRERELEASE.neo
------------------------------------------------
Use this first to test the MVS sound problem.
Only M1 and one P1 sound-init command byte change.
S1, C1/C2, V1/V2 and the container header are unchanged.
BIOS command 01 now waits in Z80 RAM after stopping sound/timers;
the ready acknowledgement is sent from RAM. Game init uses command 09.
Parameter 01 remains valid, including before FIFO dispatch.

AES: Maiya-WIP-NeoSD_AES_UNIBIOS_FIX_PRERELEASE.neo
-------------------------------------------------
Use this separately to test the UniBIOS boot graphics.
Original AES M1 and V1/V2 are preserved, including command-01 game init.
An isolated, original Maiya logo occupies unused C bank 49.
Gameplay sprite tiles do not move. Existing font/HUD pixels are copied
unchanged to private FIX banks D-F, away from system boot tiles.
Transparent BIOS tile FF and the copyright glyph are provided correctly.

Validation completed
--------------------
- Driver assembly and complete AES P1 compilation.
- Z80 execution tests: RAM acknowledgement, timer/restart behavior,
  early parameter delivery and YM register-write parity with the old driver.
- Python/native packager byte parity and region-preservation tests.
- MAME MVS boot/coin/start/gameplay with non-silent captured audio.
- MAME AES UniBIOS 4.0 splash, boot animation, title, selection and gameplay.
- GitHub upload SHA-256 hashes match the local files.

Hardware confirmation is still required. These are prerelease test files,
not a claim that every flashcart, BIOS version and multislot board is verified.
Please report board/console, BIOS version, NeoSD model/firmware, cold/warm boot,
MVS slot-switch results, coin/start sound, music/SFX and AES boot/menu behavior.

The accompanying JSON manifests document unchanged regions and SHA-256 hashes.
Reproduction and build notes are in docs/NEOSD_V171_TEST_IMAGES.md.
